headline: Venezuelan Oil Exports to US Drop Over 25% in October
summary: Venezuelan crude oil shipments to the United States fell between 27% and 29% in October according to shipping data, while US import figures showed a smaller drop of around 10%.
why: Venezuela holds the world's largest proven crude oil reserves, and changes in its export volumes to US Gulf Coast refineries impact global heavy crude trade flows.

impacts.name: Venezuelan Crude Oil
impacts.why: Shipments of Venezuelan oil to the United States declined significantly in October.
